summary: NatWest Group plc filed a 424B5 preliminary prospectus supplement for a proposed offering of Senior Callable Fixed-to-Fixed Reset Rate Notes due 20--. The notes are unsecured, unsubordinated obligations ranking pari passu with existing debt. Key terms (interest rate, maturity, spread) are left blank and will be set at pricing. The issuer retains the right to redeem at par on the Optional Redemption Date or upon certain tax/regulatory events. The notes are subject to UK bail-in powers, which could reduce principal, convert to equity, or alter terms. This is a routine debt capital markets issuance, not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, tender, activist, or restructuring is involved.
